I have created `/app/filter.py` ([filter.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py)) to sanitize HTML files in-place and remove JavaScript/XSS vectors while preserving the exact formatting of legitimate HTML content.

### Key Details
- **Zero-Reformatting HTML5 Scanner**: [`sanitize_html`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L430-L667) uses an HTML5 state-machine tag scanner ([`find_tag_end`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L204-L270)) and attribute tokenizer ([`ATTR_TOKEN_RE`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L51-L66)) to slice out only dangerous tags and attributes while leaving all safe tags, attributes, whitespace, quotes, and entity references untouched.
- **Dangerous Elements & Attributes Removed**:
  - Strips executable block elements (`<script>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<applet>`, `<portal>`) along with their contents, and dangerous frame/meta/link tags (`<iframe>`, `<frame>`, `<frameset>`, `<base>`, `<bgsound>`, `<keygen>`, `<isindex>`, `<meta http-equiv="refresh|set-cookie|...">`, `<link rel="import">`).
  - Strips all `on*` event handler attributes (including malformed attribute names) and dangerous attributes (`srcdoc`, `fscommand`, `seeksegmenttime`) via [`sanitize_start_tag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L273-L427).
  - Detects and removes obfuscated `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, and unsafe `data:` URLs (accounting for recursive HTML numeric/named entity encoding, URL percent-encoding, control characters, whitespace, and backticks) via [`is_dangerous_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L118-L154), as well as dangerous CSS expressions/imports via [`is_dangerous_style`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L157-L187) and SVG animation vectors (`<animate>`, `<set>`, `<use>`).
  - Iteratively applies sanitization until convergence in [`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ev26bsr1/filter.py#L670-L694) to prevent nested tag reconstruction attacks (e.g., `<scr<script>ipt>`).
